form_name: Border terms and the announced plan

cells.how: In form A members keep the template in step with the placements: they correct references against what is placed, replace stale plans and ask for warnings on obsolete templates so that repair does not undo the plan.
In form A the lines restrict machine hands: scripts are offered, debated and refused, and the record shows the offer more than any placing by the room's own machines.

In form A the lines restrict the claim that rooms worked without deciding their order: rooms divided the work, appointed representatives or assigned defenders, though implementation is not shown and the population count is not tested.
In form A the chat needs upkeep: expired invitations are replaced, access is restored, and decisions are brought back to the thread for members outside the chat.

In form A keeping takes conditions and links: protecting a neighbour can mean undoing the room's own overextension, keepers can refuse a change they know of as a takeover (r/de), repair follows the keeper's own idea of the right form, and a finished mark returns to renewed defence.

In form A sparing a neighbour takes conditions: it rests on overlapping membership, valued neighbouring art or fear of retaliation, and it depends on placers whom the negotiators admit they cannot control.

In form A border terms take work and meet limits: members prepare a deal inside the room, check the counterpart and cede background pixels before picture pixels, and members find that identity colours limit what they concede and that uncontrolled placers can defeat a promise.
In form A a settled border is kept only in part: restraint often comes before any settlement is shown, and a treaty guides the members who learn and accept it while others keep placing against it.

In form A help is part of the bargain more than its result: pixels and shared upkeep are offered as the terms, or help is already under way when the bargaining starts, so help delivered after a settled border is not shown.

In form A the marking is provisional and contested: success is judged and credit disputed and corrected while the work goes on, an announced finish reopens the work, and members celebrate a damaged remnant or partial progress.

In form A the record holds more than the result: members mourn a destroyed neighbour with a memorial artwork, keep an imagined version of the hoped-for design, help a viewer find a small surviving mark in the final image, and keep a preferred intact image beside the damaged final one.

changes.how: Calls and reported building coexist without identifying the reporting builders as people recruited by those calls
An individual's departure under pressure differs from the collective restart explicitly attributed to defeat rather than a measured shortage of hands
The explicit departure is from one picture rather than all pixel work and does not establish an interpersonal quarrel or its repair
Reported scripting pressure and a script offer do not establish that manual upkeep failure caused this room to automate
An instructional response answers a routing question without establishing that a template settled an agreed design
Members correct references against current placements and replace stale plans rather than only correcting placements against a fixed reference
Conflicting repairs, loss and notification requests do not by themselves establish that uninformed keepers caused the loss of every planned addition
One participant's restoration report does not establish compliance by contributors outside the organizing venues
An editable placement script is offered without verified execution or extra placements by this room
Visible invitations and returned message reports do not expose the chat's decisions or verify their effects on placements
Setting up a chat and rallying around the prism fits venue setup without reconstructing how the room originally formed around the mark
Keeping already placed parts overlaps near-completion reports rather than following the end of all building
A proposed skilled-builder and janitor division makes organizing explicit without proving compliance or refuting the cross-room prevalence claim
Loss of the planned addition explicitly motivates a request to notify chat and mobilize repairs
A reported invasion receives a restoration response rather than an observed refusal of an initiating attack call
A complaint offers alliance and later receives a compromise announcement without showing an attack call redirected into negotiation
A stated defeat motivates a renewed allied attempt, returning organizing to mobilization despite the model leaving this loop undrawn
Protecting the neighbouring flag can require undoing an overextended contribution associated with one's own mark
A truce conditioned on overwriting the protected picture can be rejected and followed by a removal threat rather than restraint
A removal threat and an encroachment complaint document threatened or reported aggression rather than independently verified placement by their speakers
A completion report that asks for the next task falls outside the asks-nothing-back definition
Conditional location negotiation does not establish overriding jurisdiction over all neighbouring placers
An early refusal to move does not establish activity before every loss, while the later restart explicitly answers defeat
Milestone celebration coexists with further reference correction and repairs rather than requiring completion of the whole work
Celebration and later records are visible without an explicit mechanism linking celebration to seeking preservation
Disagreement about survival establishes competing accounts rather than an adjudicated cause or a community-wide change of mind
A preservation-script offer is refused, so upkeep strain must not be treated as demonstrated deployment of machine hands.
Insufficient hands can justify holding current work and refusing expansion rather than leaving the spot.
A font image answers design criticism, but the maker later changes fonts, so posting a template need not settle the design permanently.
The aggregate prevalence claim is locally untestable, while explicit rules and credited jobs prevent treating this room as lacking decided elements.
Reports about timers and refreshing do not independently verify a glitch, its cause or extra pixels reaching the shared canvas.
Standards are connected to progress and chat routing in the same public instructions rather than exclusively separate coordination routes.
Repeated undoing prompts an unresolved choice between moving and persevering rather than a demonstrated relocation.
The evidence supports a refresh-script offer, refusal and bot debate rather than confirmed automated placing.
Visible invitations and returned decisions establish routing but not how the off-platform group reached agreement.
Creating a venue within an existing community does not demonstrate stranger-led community origins or a durable independent body.
Construction and repair overlap before the quotation is declared complete.
Naming a rival does not reconstruct the prior dispute or prove that every clash derives from inherited antagonism.
Invoked rivalry does not determine treatment of a group that another speaker credits with helping the project.
Teasing responses to divided support do not establish actual dual subscription, reassurance or resolved affiliation.
The record reaches a guest-space request inside the mark, not confirmed acceptance or a general hosting regime.
Public rival-thread observation and secrecy rhetoric do not establish infiltration of a private chat.
Reception varies between rejection and explaining the joke rather than constituting a uniformly welcoming intake.
Pride accompanies visible participation before whole-work completion, so a fully finished quotation is not required.
Affection for the drawing and pleasurable participation are explicit motives for remaking, while an effect of preserving records is not established.
Contraction can mean dropping an over-demanding additional figure while retaining the principal quotation.
Continuation remains contested because another speaker judges repeating the quotation not worthwhile.
Remaking in another medium begins while the original canvas remains live.
The closure rule must be scoped to the original canvas because successor creation and placement mistakes are reported after it ends.
Repair follows the keeper's understanding of correctness, which can itself contain the spelling error being restored.
Insiders alternate humorous alteration and repair of the same text, including restoring their own change and becoming maintainers.
Calls and work reports establish a local building sequence without tracing every recruited person's pixels.
A brief offer answering an explanation does not establish an invitation preference mechanism or an obligation on every reader to respond.
The capacity doubt receives a report of starting the plan rather than evidence of relocation after defeat.
The visible standards do not reveal the backstage conversation that settled the design.
Fictional identity and playful antagonism do not identify a preexisting rival room named as an attack target.
A participant outside chat explicitly depends on returned design information to keep public participation aligned with shared plans.
Returning decisions to accessible threads lets people without chat access follow design and alliance changes.
Anticipated restorative repairs and upkeep costs can defeat a proposed redesign even when fictional accuracy favours revision.
An alarm receives a report of prior diplomacy rather than evidence that this alarm produced the negotiation.
Recognition of others' work and ethical objections support restraint without a demonstrated preceding treaty.
Reported allied defence does not establish shortage causing an intercommunity appeal that brought those helpers.
The reasoned acknowledgment answers an outside maker's ownership request rather than an internal member declining an attack call.
The sharing offer belongs to the mockup square encounter rather than a demonstrated truce answering the separate sign conversion.
Permission to occupy guest space requires the requesting makers to maintain their own work without establishing completed occupancy.
Recognition of an existing maker explains yielding without proving the request selected the new goal already reported as chosen.
Contrasting covering criteria do not establish a direct debate about the canvas's purpose or a settled collective ethic.
A small memorial artwork remembers a destroyed neighbour rather than merely restoring pixels or retaining a joke.
Repeated maintenance does not imply automation when participants explicitly describe their team working without scripts or bots.
Celebration and records overlap without a passage showing that celebration caused archiving.
A stale-view remedy does not prove that a separately reported posttimer alteration occurred only in a local client.
A participant explains manual success through a good group, early arrival and avoided targeting without establishing those conditions independently.
Future proposals remain constrained by maintenance concerns and contrasting individual script predictions rather than a demonstrated collective decision.
Correcting a design understanding does not establish a dispute over retained copies, cleanup requests or historical scars.
Reported arrival and interest in the show do not establish durable viewing, retention or aggregate subscriber growth.
